name: hometax
description: HomeTax electronic tax invoice CLI and Claude Code plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: hometax
plugins.description: Query and manage Korean electronic tax invoices on HomeTax with a file-based NPKI certificate. Reads sales and purchase invoices, period totals, invoice detail and the registered counterparty book; writes (issue, correct, cancel, counterparty add/edit/delete) preview first and send only with an explicit --yes. Unofficial reproduction of the HomeTax web client's internal requests.
